description:
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple's Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It's Apple's central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless.

Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here.

Retail and Marcom Engineering, an IS&T team, builds and operates the systems and experiences that connect Apple's products with its customers. The team owns the technology behind both Apple's online and physical stores and drives the interactive marketing experiences and tools that keep creative operations moving. Together, those functions deliver the technology behind every product story Apple tells and every purchase a customer makes.


Description
As an iOS software engineer on Retail POS Engineering, you will design, build, and support the SwiftUI interfaces behind Apple's point of sale interfaces and experiences used by Apple Retail employees and customers in every Apple Store across 25 countries. You will working closely with engineers, designers, and business partners to turn retail needs into reliable, accessible experiences.


Responsibilities
Builds and maintains point of sale interfaces for iOS using Swift and SwiftUI
Clarifies the reasons behind requirements before designing a solution
Partners with engineers, designers, business partners, and contractors to deliver features
Writes automated and unit tests to protect quality as the app evolves
Diagnoses and resolves production issues, tracing problems to their root cause
Communicates status, risks, and opportunities to stakeholders
Applies AI tools to improve development speed and quality


Minimum qualifications
BS in Computer Science or a highly related field 
2+ years of professional software development experience
2+ years of experience building iOS apps with Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS SDK
Production support experience on a shipped iOS application


Preferred qualifications
Experience with point-of-sale, payments, or transactional retail applications
Developed accessibility best practices in iOS apps
Experience analyzing and developing software development techniques, methodologies, client-server interfaces, and tools
Knowledge of iOS design patterns and Apple's Human Interface Guidelines
Up to speed on the latest iOS version changes, features, and requirements
Experience writing automated tests and unit tests as part of the development process
Experience leveraging AI to expand on your development efficiency
Proven ability to work effectively with multi-functional engineering teams, designers, business partners, and contractors
Ability to manage multiple projects at once
Self-starting and self-directed
Enthusiasm for quality, attention to detail, and overall customer experience
Strong problem solver who enjoys finding the needle in the haystack
